visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a bright red outdoor jacket, black pants, and a yellow beret, walks away from the camera along a narrow dirt hiking trail. The trail is densely lined with blooming pink cherry blossom trees creating a floral tunnel effect under a clear, bright blue sky. She carries a black backpack and trekking poles, moving with an energetic gait. (2) The camera transitions to close-up shots of delicate pink cherry blossoms against the sky, followed by a drone shot over a traditional wooden gate with large characters. A winding asphalt road is visible from above, bordered by a sea of pink flowers. (3) The woman is seen running towards the camera and spinning with her arms outstretched under the canopy. Her facial expressions are joyful and relaxed. Later, she sits on a bench beside a man in a blue jacket, both viewed from behind as they look out at the floral landscape. (4) Close-up shots focus on her face as she leans against a branch of blossoms with her eyes closed, then smiling warmly at the camera. The background shows a vast mountain landscape with steep slopes covered in pink trees and small village structures in the distance under bright, natural daylight.
